annotations.title: Get the status of a fax

description: Read where a fax is. Give the id from create_fax, or an address of the fax: the status address from the tracking prompt of the person, or the address of a page of the fax. "status" is pending, delivered, failed or expired. While it is pending, "stage" says more: rendering (we prepare the pages), awaiting_payment (the person did not pay yet; "pages" and "price" are given, and they can still change), sending (paid, on its way). delivered: the fax arrived. failed: the fax was not delivered, the person is not charged, and can send it again; with "render_failed", the document could not be prepared, and the person opens the link to change it. expired: the fax was not paid in time. Do not call this in a loop: read the status when the person asks.

id.description: The id of the fax, or an address of the fax: its status address (https://.../api/fax/{id}/status), or the address of its preview, payment or confirmation page.
